title: Ukrainian police and FBI arrest four suspected ransomware group members
date_note: Date of announcement; arrest day not stated in sources read
geo_basis: Detentions in Kyiv and 11 regions; pin at Kyiv
summary: Ukraine's National Police, working with the FBI, detained four suspected members of an international ransomware group after a two-year investigation, with 66 searches in Kyiv and 11 regions. Police say at least 28 companies paid more than $40.5 million. Court records identify the Chaos encryptor; authorities have not confirmed ties to BlackSuit or Conti.
plain: Ukrainian police, helped by the FBI, arrested four people accused of ransomware attacks that earned over $40 million from companies.
exec: The group used fake IT-support calls; help-desk impersonation remains a live ransomware entry route.
action: Verify IT-support callers through a known number, and block unapproved remote-access tools such as TeamViewer and AnyDesk.
impact: At least 28 companies paid more than $40.5 million, per Ukraine's National Police as reported

validation.note: BleepingComputer, relaying the National Police announcement (npu.gov.ua, not opened); Atlabyte rewrites it. SC Media headline not read (page unreachable).
